description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different models in abstractive summarization from audio transcription, measured by ROUGE-1 scores across varying values of the hyperparameter $ r $, which is represented on a logarithmic scale. The x-axis, labeled "log r," spans from approximately 1 to 8, with major tick marks at intervals of 2, indicating a logarithmic progression. The y-axis, labeled "ROUGE-1," ranges from 5 to 35, with major gridlines at intervals of 5. Four distinct models are compared: T5 + LoRA (red line with circular markers), MBart + LoRA (blue line with circular markers), T5 + AdaLoRA (green line with circular markers), and MBart + AdaLoRA (orange line with circular markers). The T5 + LoRA model shows a steady increase in ROUGE-1 score from approximately 24 to 32 as $ \log r $ increases. The MBart + LoRA model exhibits a more volatile trend, starting at a low score of around 5, rising to about 11 at $ \log r = 2 $, dropping to 7 at $ \log r = 3 $, and then sharply increasing to 32 at $ \log r = 8 $. The T5 + AdaLoRA model demonstrates a consistent upward trend, starting at approximately 24 and reaching a score of about 34. The MBart + AdaLoRA model shows the highest performance, starting at a low score of around 6, increasing to about 17 at $ \log r = 2 $, then sharply rising to 35 at $ \log r = 3 $, and continuing to increase to a peak of approximately 36 at $ \log r = 8 $.
